title: Requiem & Decryption
subtitle: Clues, card order and Lich hunts

entries.title: How a Hunt Works
entries.summary: One full round, from clues to rewards

blocks.text: How you order your Requiem cards is your affair, my little adversary. So is the price of getting it wrong.

This chapter's target is the boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. Knocking it down is not enough, Tenno. First work out an <hl>answer</hl> that belongs to you alone, then end it with that answer in place; only then does the hunt succeed.

items.text: Wake your nemesis: while you have no Lich, a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_larvling} turns up near you every so often. Knock it down and execute it with {lang:key.kuvalich.mercy}, and your {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} is born, carrying the weapon the downed Larvling revealed, level and element included. [[enemies/kuva_larvling|More]]

Wake your nemesis: while you have no Lich, a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_larvling} turns up near you every so often. Kill it yourself, and your {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} is born, carrying the weapon settled when the Larvling appeared. [[enemies/kuva_larvling|More]]

Gather clues: once your Lich is born, knock down the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s that come for you and finish them with {lang:key.kuvalich.mercy} to build decryption progress. Each full stage reveals one card of the answer. [[requiem/decryption|More]]

Gather clues: once your Lich is born, kill the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s that come for you yourself to build decryption progress. Each full stage reveals one card of the answer. [[requiem/decryption|More]]

items: Get the cards: there are 8 kinds of Requiem Cards, and your answer is 3 of them, so you need those three in hand. Mining {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} drops them, and you can trade 3 cards you don't need for 1 random new one. [[requiem/requiem_cards|More]]
Set the cards: place the three cards in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} in the order you guess. [[requiem/requiem_gate|More]]

items.text: Hunt: once its rage is full, your {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} comes to you. Its health has three segments and it goes down each time one empties; execute it with {lang:key.kuvalich.mercy}: the 1st time checks card 1, the 2nd the first two, and only all three right on the 3rd ends it. [[enemies/kuva_master|More]]
Hunt: once its rage is full, your {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} comes to you. Stay close when you kill it; the answer is checked the moment it falls. [[enemies/kuva_master|More]]

Result: all three right is a decryption success; it is ended for good, and once you collect the rewards a new round begins. One wrong card and it breaks free and escapes with Lich rank +1; it will be back, so adjust your cards and try again. [[requiem/decrypt_failure|More]]

Result: a right guess is a decryption success, and once you collect the rewards a new round begins. A wrong guess and it escapes with Lich rank +1; it will be back, so adjust your cards and try again. [[requiem/decrypt_failure|More]]

blocks.text: Look up unfamiliar terms in [[start/glossary]].

In the Origin System, a Kuva Lich takes over planets on the Star Chart. Run missions in its territory and it skims a share of everything you earn; the records call it a tax, and you only get it back once the Lich is defeated. Taxing the Operator? Ordis would wring the <x>Ku-- Kuva out of it, drop by drop by DROP--</x> ahem. Line interference. Please disregard.

entries.title: Decryption Progress
entries.summary: Finish off Kuva enemies to reveal three clues

blocks.text: Your <hl>answer</hl> belongs to you alone, Tenno, and no one can guess it for you. It is 3 [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in a fixed order. It starts out hidden, and once your Lich is born you uncover it one card at a time by putting down Kuva enemies for <t>decryption progress</t>.

cells: Your own {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}, on a failed decryption (an incomplete set counts)
Your own {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}, with an incomplete set or a wrong guess

rows: Someone else's Lich, an ownerless Lich, anything else
Anything at all, while you have no Lich

blocks.text: {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s won't come after you, so decryption progress comes only from your Lich; see [[enemies/kuva_master]].

blocks.title: Only executions count
blocks.text: A downed Thrall gives progress only if you finish it with {lang:key.kuvalich.mercy}; leave it and it soon fades away, leaving nothing. Thralls you knock down yourself, ones your pets knock down, and ones finished by a fire or lava you caused are all yours to execute.

blocks.title: Land the killing blow yourself
blocks.text: A Thrall only gives progress when a player lands the killing blow with their own hand. Kills by pets, lava, or bonus element damage such as burning or electricity don't count. Finish them off yourself, with melee or arrows.

blocks.title: Farm together
blocks.text: When a Thrall falls, every player with a Lich within <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.thrallProgressShareRange}</t> blocks gets the same decryption progress, so there's no need to fight over the last hit; drops and Lich rage go only to whoever finished it. Players without a Lich get no progress.
Three stages

items: Each full stage reveals one answer card and progress starts over; <g>leftover points carry into the next stage</g>.
<hl>The moment Clue 1 appears, the whole answer is locked in</hl>, and which 3 cards go in which order never changes after that.
Revealed cards show up in the [[requiem/requiem_gate]] and the [[requiem/lich_archive]]. <w>Their arrangement is random and does not show the order.</w>
After all three clues are revealed, kills stop adding progress and the action bar reminds you to set your cards.

blocks.text: The archives call this progress Murmurs, a rather graceful name. Each full stage reveals one Requiem mod, and once all three are full, the whole answer lies open.

Whenever you gain progress, a Kuva crystal appears at the top center of the screen. Its outline lights up clockwise and the liquid inside rises, both showing this stage's progress; beneath it reads “{lang:kuvalich.hud.murmur.label}”, three small diamonds show how many clues are revealed, and once you have a Lich, its name sits at the bottom. It fades after about <t>4</t> seconds, and the action bar reports how many points you just gained.
When a clue is revealed, the crystal turns into that card's own symbol with the card's name beneath it; once all three are revealed, the three symbols appear side by side.

blocks.title: Progress stays with you
blocks.text: Progress, clues and the answer are stored on you, so dying, logging out or changing dimensions loses nothing, and everyone keeps their own; your Lich answers to yours alone. Only a <g>successful decryption</g> clears them, and the next round rolls a new answer.
From the moment your Lich is born, anything you pick up may be confiscated by it; see [[requiem/confiscation]].
Deep intel

items: For a Lich, both ends of the Thrall range are multiplied and rounded down, and the progress is a random value between them.
The success that completes a decryption adds no progress; the round's progress is cleared at once.
One gain reveals at most one card, even if the points would cover two stages.

items.text: A downed Thrall that nobody executes within <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.mercyDownedSeconds}</t> seconds fades away with no progress and no loot. So does one that nobody is entitled to execute, such as one knocked down by another mob.

A Thrall finished by bonus [[combat/elements|element]] damage, such as burning or gas damage over time or the extra hit from electricity or blast, does not count at all. You get no progress and none of its loot. The same goes for kills by pets or lava.

entries.title: Lich Profile
entries.summary: Who your Lich is, its rage, your attempts

blocks.text: Your Lich is a creature of the Queens. It does not deserve your awe. Still, you need to know who it is, what it is doing and how close it is to coming for you, and all of that is in this profile, Tenno. It opens only from the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate}: click “{lang:key.kuvalich.lich_archive}” in its bottom right, or press <t>K</t> while the gate is open.

items: <t>K</t> is the default key and can be changed in Controls; press it again or Esc to close.
The game keeps running while the profile is open; it does not pause.

items.text: It cannot be opened during an execution.

items: You can also open it from the small text in the bottom-right corner of the [[requiem/requiem_gate]] screen.

Until you have a Lich, the center shows only a dark silhouette and the status line reads “{lang:kuvalich.archive.status.unborn}” and “{lang:kuvalich.archive.status.unborn.hint}”; the right column still shows your current cards and the first stage's progress.

blocks.text: Who it is

rows: The diamond badge at the top left shows its current <t>Lich rank</t>; hover to see what the next rank will change, see [[enemies/kuva_escalation]]
The name it was born with; the line below says which of your Liches it is and its personality

cells: A row of small icons: adaptation, battle fury (the [[enemies/battle_boost|Battle Boost]]), regeneration, quake and lifesteal; hover for details and exact numbers
A row of small icons: adaptation, regeneration, quake and lifesteal; hover for details and exact numbers
The dots under each ability icon show its strength: one weak, two average, three strong; the icon with a red outline is its signature, see [[enemies/lich_traits]]

rows: The rage bar and its current tier, from low to high: {lang:kuvalich.lich.rage.0}, {lang:kuvalich.lich.rage.1}, {lang:kuvalich.lich.rage.2}, {lang:kuvalich.lich.rage.3}, {lang:kuvalich.lich.rage.4}. Hover to see what is feeding its rage

cells: Health and armor, roughly how hard one blow hits you (at the current difficulty, including the extra damage from its rank, without battle fury), weaknesses, resistances, adaptation, the weapon it carries with that weapon's level and element, birthplace, battle fury, your damage to it and its damage to you, and encounters, listing only the rows that apply to it

Health and armor, roughly how hard one blow hits you (at the current difficulty, including the extra damage from its rank), weaknesses, resistances, adaptation, the weapon it carries with that weapon's level and element, birthplace, your damage to it and its damage to you, and encounters, listing only the rows that apply to it
Every confiscated item is listed here, see [[requiem/confiscation]]

blocks.text: What it is doing

rows: The Lich itself; drag to turn it around. Now and then it speaks

cells: The line under the model: stalking, withdrawn, coming for you, nearby, downed. When its rage is full but it cannot come, it says what it is waiting for
The line under the model: stalking, withdrawn, coming for you, nearby. When its rage is full but it cannot come, it says what it is waiting for

rows: The three cards in your Requiem Gate and how many uses each has left
Your last <t>5</t> judgements: each position lights up if right, gets a red slash if wrong, and stays dim if it was never reached
The same three symbols as in the Requiem Gate; <w>their arrangement does not tell you the correct order</w>

blocks.text: Rage
Watch the rage bar. Once it is full, your Lich sets out to find you; how it arrives is covered in [[enemies/kuva_master]].

items.text: Executing a Thrall: +<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.lichRagePerThrallExecution|pct}</t>
Killing a Thrall yourself: +<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.lichRagePerThrallExecution|pct}</t>
Each point of decryption progress: +<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.lichRagePerProgressPoint|pct}</t>
Each Clue revealed: +<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.lichRagePerClueRevealed|pct}</t>
Time: from online time alone, it fills from empty in <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.lichRageOnlineMinutes}</t> minutes

items: Rage does not rise while it is on its way or present, and every encounter ends with it back at zero
The rage tier only shows how eager it is; it does not make the Lich any stronger

blocks.text: Requiem Cards are the keys you slot into the [[requiem/requiem_gate]]. There are 8 kinds, and your answer is <t>3 different cards</t> among them, in a fixed order. There is also a wildcard, Oull, covered at the end.

items: kuvalich:khra
kuvalich:jahu
kuvalich:fass
kuvalich:lohk
kuvalich:netra
kuvalich:vome
kuvalich:xata
kuvalich:ris
blocks.caption: All 8 Requiem Cards

blocks.text: The 3 cards are all different, which allows 8 × 7 × 6 = <t>336</t> sequences, and the Gate won't take two copies of the same card either.
Only a success costs durability

items: Each <g>successful decryption</g> takes 1 use from each of the three cards in the Gate. One set lasts at most <t>3</t> successes.
<g>A failed decryption costs no durability</g>. Inserting, removing or reordering cards costs nothing either, so testing orders is free.

After a success, cards with uses left <g>stay in their slots in the Requiem Gate</g>, ready for the next [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] without setting them up again; a card that runs out simply vanishes. The next answer is rolled anew, so the cards left there may no longer be right; rearrange them by the new clues.
Requiem Cards don't stack; one per slot.

blocks.text: All 8 names on these cards come from the Requiem mods of the Origin System. There, too, each has a limited number of uses and is gone once they run out.
Where to get them

rows: Each block may drop 1 random card; chances below, details in [[world/requiem_ore]]
Any 3 cards become 1 random <g>new card</g>, see [[weapons/requiem_recast]]
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseCardDropChance|pctv}</t>; <w>each Fortune level lowers it by {cfg:kuva_lich.fortuneReductionPerLevel|pctv}</w>, down to <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minCardDropChance|pctv}</t>

blocks.title: Recycle worn cards
blocks.text: Don't throw worn cards away. Put three yellow cards with 1 use left into the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} to get back 1 fresh card with 3 uses. The new card is equally likely to be any of the 8 and may repeat one you put in.
Oull, the wildcard

items: kuvalich:oull
blocks.caption: Wildcard Requiem Card

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:oull} is a ninth Requiem Card whose face cycles through the eight symbols. <g>It counts as correct in any slot</g>, standing in for any card of the answer.

items: Only one can be equipped at a time: like every other card, only one of a kind fits in the Gate, so once it holds an Oull, a second one won't go in.
Like the others it has <t>3</t> uses, spent only on a successful decryption.
It can't be mined, can't go into the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast}, and the three-for-one never yields it.

blocks.title: How to get it
blocks.text: When an execution of your Lich fails but the first stab was right, you have a {cfg:kuva_lich.oullDropChance|pctv} chance to get an Oull; if your inventory is full, it drops at your feet. A failure on the very first stab gives none.

blocks.title: How to get it
blocks.text: There is currently no way to get an Oull.
In the Origin System, Oull is likewise a wildcard Requiem mod that can stand in for any other.

entries.title: Requiem Gate
entries.summary: Setting cards, the challenge and rewards
items: kuvalich:requiem_gate

blocks.text: Entrust your judgment to this gate, Tenno, then go and prove it.

The {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} is the block that holds your answer. Put three [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in it in the order you guess; when the moment comes to move against your [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]], those three cards decide the outcome. Before you strike, check your card order again.
The screen

rows: Your answer, positions 1, 2, 3 from left to right; the three red dots under each slot show how many uses that card has left

Each revealed clue is drawn as that card's symbol and each unrevealed one as a Kuva crystal; on the one being decrypted, the outline and liquid show this stage's progress; <w>they swap places every few seconds, and their arrangement has nothing to do with the order</w>

blocks.title: Cards live on you, not in the block
blocks.text: Closing the screen saves the cards to your own data, so every Requiem Gate shows you your own cards and shows others theirs. Breaking the block drops no cards.
The hunt

items: First finish off a [[enemies/kuva_larvling|Kuva Larvling]] so your Lich is born, then build progress to reveal clues; see [[requiem/decryption]].
Right-click the Requiem Gate, fill all three slots with cards and close the screen to save.

items.text: Wait for its rage to fill and for it to come to you, or call it straight to you with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}; see [[enemies/kuva_master]].
Wait for its rage to fill and for it to come to you; see [[enemies/kuva_master]].

It goes down each time you empty one of its three health segments; reach it within <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.mercyDownedSeconds}</t> seconds and finish it with {lang:key.kuvalich.mercy}: the 1st time checks card 1, the 2nd the first two, and the 3rd must get all three right.
Kill it while you are within <t>64</t> blocks of it; the answer is checked the moment it falls.
Check the result. All three right drops rewards; on a wrong stab, chat tells you which stab went wrong (see [[requiem/decrypt_failure]]).
Check the result. A success drops rewards; on a failure, chat tells you how many positions in a row you got right, counting from the first (see [[requiem/decrypt_failure]]).

cells: Still judged stab by stab, and an empty slot counts as wrong: reaching the first empty slot is a decryption failure, same as “3 cards, wrong”
Not a judgement: it dissolves and leaves, you only get progress, and it will be back later

rows: <g>Decryption success</g>: it is ended for good, you get the rewards below, and the round resets
Decryption failure: it breaks free and escapes, [[requiem/decrypt_failure|Lich rank]] +1, no durability lost, and you still get progress

blocks.text: Success rewards

rows: 1, the very weapon it carries, with the level and element settled when the Larvling appeared
Stay in the Requiem Gate for the next one

items: Kuva weapons come only from successful Lich hunts. The kind is the one your Lich was born carrying, which you can check in advance in the [[requiem/lich_archive]], and its level is rolled within your weapon level range; see [[weapons/kuva_weapons]].

A new character's range is <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMinimumLevel}~{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMaximumLevel}</t>, and your first Larvling's weapon level is rolled inside it. Each later success raises the range until it hits its cap; see [[weapons/weapon_level]].

Mods are upgrade cards you fit to a weapon or to yourself, and the high-tier mod here comes from the top two quality tiers, {cfg:kuva_lich.masterPrimeModuleChance|pctv} Prime and the rest Riven; see [[modules/module_rarity]].
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> of them are weapon mods and the rest are Warframe mods. Here the “Warframe” is you, so Warframe mods go on yourself.

blocks.title: Rewards drop where it falls
blocks.text: <w>Don't finish it near lava, the void or deep water</w>. Every reward drops where the Lich falls.
Deep intel

items: Stay within <t>8</t> blocks of the Gate while its screen is open.
Only one card of each kind can go in, Oull included; duplicates placed in the past are returned to your inventory when you open the Gate, dropping at your feet if it is full.

items.text: To get progress from your Lich without risking a failure, take one card out of the Gate first.

items: After a successful decryption, unspent cards stay in the Gate and take no inventory space.

items.text: An execution is judged by the cards in the Gate when it starts; swapping or adding cards partway through doesn't count, and an empty slot counts as wrong.

items: After each success, the minimum and maximum of your weapon level range both rise by the same random amount, {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevelCapIncrease}~{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevelCapIncrease}, capped at {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevel} and {cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevel} respectively.
Both ends rise by the same amount, so the range keeps its width until one end hits its cap. This kill's weapon was settled with the range from before the increase.
In Creative mode, press <t>TAB</t> in the Requiem Gate to fill in the correct answer. It only works once at least 1 clue is revealed, and your old cards go back to your inventory.

entries.title: Failure & Guessing the Order
entries.summary: What a wrong guess costs, and max tries

blocks.text: Test orders methodically, because the cost of a wrong guess stays on you until a decryption succeeds. Executing your [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] with a wrong order, or with an empty slot, is a decryption failure: it breaks free and escapes, you get a hint to narrow things down, and the cost is Lich rank +1.

Test orders methodically, because the cost of a wrong guess stays on you until a decryption succeeds. Going after your [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] with all three slots filled but wrong is a decryption failure: it breaks free and escapes, you get a hint to narrow things down, and the cost is Lich rank +1.
Hints on failure

cells: Position 1 is wrong; nothing about the other two
Position 1 is right and position 2 is wrong; nothing about position 3
Positions 1 and 2 are right; only position 3 is wrong
Positions 1 and 2 are right; only position 3 is wrong
Position 1 is wrong; nothing about the other two

blocks.text: Judgement only runs from the left, and position 2 is checked only when position 1 is right; it stops at the first wrong card.
During an execution, three cells sit at the bottom of the screen. Each correct stab lights one; the wrong one glows red with a slash through it, and the cells after it stay dark.

blocks.title: When the first two are right
blocks.text: If your three cards are all different and the first two are right, the third card is not in the answer at all, so swap in a different one.
When you know all three cards

items: Put the three cards in any order and make your first attempt on it.
If position 1 is right, swap the last two, and the next try wins.
If position 1 is wrong, move one of the other two cards into position 1 and try again.
If position 1 is still wrong, it must be the remaining card. Put it in place; you can miss at most once more, and if you do, swap the last two.

blocks.text: This way you fail at most 3 times, and the 4th try always wins. With a {item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle} in hand, use it and you won't miss even once. The execution record in the [[requiem/lich_archive]] keeps your last 5 results.
The cost of failing: Lich rank

Each failure raises your Lich rank by 1: “{lang:kuvalich.mercy.banner.rank_up}” flashes on screen, chat reports the new rank, and the rank badge on the boss bar and in the [[requiem/lich_archive]] changes with it. A Lich is born at rank 1. The rank is stored on you, survives death and logging out, and only a successful decryption clears it; the next Lich starts again at 1.
Damage Kuva enemies deal to you × (1 + (Lich rank − 1) × {cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage})
Damage you deal to Kuva enemies × (1 − (Lich rank − 1) × {cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage}), reduced by at most 99.9%

blocks.title: Only against Kuva enemies
blocks.text: Your Lich rank only affects damage between you and Kuva enemies, which means Thralls and Liches. Damage involving falls, other mobs or other people is unaffected, so everyday exploring goes on as usual.
Your Lich rank does not change the damage you deal or take; a wrong guess only adds 1 to the number.
A Lich of the Origin System, stabbed by a Parazon fitted with the wrong Requiem mods, does not fall. It ranks up instead and grows stronger. Ordis files such things with distaste.

blocks.title: Don't drag it out
blocks.text: Once a Kuva enemy has a target, its damage grows by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct}</t> of its base every second (see [[enemies/battle_boost]]). If the hunt turns against you, back off first; once it loses its target, the boost drains at the same rate. I would rather you win late than fall here.

entries.title: Confiscation & Return
entries.summary: The Lich takes pickups until you win

blocks.text: Whatever your Lich takes, you get all of it back only when the decryption succeeds, Tenno. From the moment your Lich is born until you win the round, anything you pick up may be confiscated by [[enemies/kuva_master|it]], the whole stack at once.
It isn't theft, friend. It's a tax. You'll get used to it.

rows: When you touch a dropped item to pick it up
From your Lich's birth (finishing a Kuva Larvling) until a successful decryption
Everything at once when you end it

blocks.title: It takes the whole stack
blocks.text: It takes <w>the entire stack</w> you were picking up, so a dropped stack of 64 diamonds means all 64 are gone. The limit counts confiscations, one per stack, not individual items.

items: Items already in your inventory are never taken.
When something is confiscated, the action bar says who took what, and now and then the Lich sneers at you over the comm.
Confiscated items are recorded on you; dying, logging out or changing dimensions does not lose them, and the [[requiem/lich_archive]] lists them.
A failed decryption returns nothing and does not reset the limit; only a success counts.
Picking up your own drops after dying rolls for every stack as well.

blocks.title: With a full inventory, step off the drops
blocks.text: A normal pickup rolls once, but when a full inventory keeps you from picking an item up, it rolls 20 times a second, so the longer you stand there, the likelier you are to lose it. Until the decryption succeeds, keep a few slots free.
Getting it back
When a successful decryption ends your Lich, every last confiscated item drops at the spot where it fell, and chat tells you so. The round is over by then, so picking them up is safe.
They are ordinary dropped items; they despawn if left too long and burn in lava. Pick them up quickly.

entries.title: Requiem Items

kuvalich:requiem_riddle
kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum

blocks.text: Decryption and hunts use four items: a gem for crafting blocks, a riddle that shows the answer, an ultimatum that calls your [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] to you, and the reliquary you only get from a successful hunt.

items: kuvalich:requiem_gem
kuvalich:requiem_riddle
kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum
kuvalich:lich_reliquary

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem}

It drops from {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s you execute, at a base chance of <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemBaseChance|pctv}</t> plus <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemLootingBonus|pctv}</t> per level of <t>Looting</t> on your main-hand weapon at the moment of the execution.

It drops from {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s you kill yourself, at a base chance of <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemBaseChance|pctv}</t> plus <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemLootingBonus|pctv}</t> per level of <t>Looting</t> on your main-hand weapon.
{item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle}
Right-click it and chat tells you this round's <hl>three cards in the correct order</hl>. Each use consumes 1.

items: You need at least 1 clue revealed first. Used too early, it is not consumed; it only says there is no answer yet and goes on a <t>10</t>-second cooldown.
It has no recipe and never drops; you can only find it in the Creative tab.

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}

Right-click to call your own {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} without waiting for its rage. It speaks over the comm first, and about {cfg:kuva_lich.lichCommLeadTicks|sec} later it appears 5~9 blocks in front of you; used on a block, it prefers the space just outside the face you clicked. Each use consumes 1, except in Creative.

Right-click to call your own {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} without waiting for its rage. It speaks over the comm first and appears right after, 5~9 blocks in front of you; used on a block, it prefers the space just outside the face you clicked. Each use consumes 1, except in Creative.

items.text: If you have no Lich yet, if it is already on its way or nearby, or if it cannot reach you (a dimension it does not hunt in, Peaceful, or you are mid-execution), the Ultimatum is not used up and the action bar tells you why.

If you have no Lich yet, if it is already on its way or nearby, or if it cannot reach you (a dimension it does not hunt in, or Peaceful), the Ultimatum is not used up and the action bar tells you why.

items: Using it fills the Lich's rage at once, even if it just left and is still on cooldown.
After use, the Ultimatum has a <t>2</t>-second cooldown so it cannot be spammed.
If there is nowhere to stand in front of you, it appears somewhere out of your sight instead.

blocks.text: A successful decryption has a <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.requiemUltimatumDropChance|pctv}</t> chance to drop one.
It has no recipe and never drops; you can only find it in the Creative tab.
What answers is your Lich itself, not a drill. Set your cards and gear up first, then use it somewhere open and safe.
{item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary}
Every successful decryption drops exactly 1. The three blocks below all need one to craft, so you cannot build any of them before your first successful hunt.
With the TACZ gun mod installed, it can also permanently enhance guns in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, see [[tacz/tacz_enhance]].
{item:kuvalich:kuva} and {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} are the other main hunt rewards; see [[start/materials]] for their uses.
